name: cosmic-portal
title: Cosmic Portal
description: A full 3D cosmic scene: a starry void with a luminous torus frame, circling rings and floating crystals around a bright core. A pulse and a recolour can be triggered from outside.
use: A sci-fi landing page, game menu or product reveal wants a showy interactive 3D centerpiece.
avoid: A heavy WebGL scene with bloom that needs a fixed-height parent and a capable GPU.
a11y: A decorative WebGL scene with no ARIA label, no keyboard orbit and no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall dark panel is filled with a green-tinted starfield. A large thin ring frames a bright white core, circled by flatter pink and violet hoops, with small glowing orbs and a pale crystal near the middle. Two coloured buttons sit under the panel.
behaves: The camera drifts and orbits slowly around the core. The rings spin and the crystals float, while Activate sends a bright pulse outward and Shift Dimensions swaps the colour scheme.
customise: Colours, crystalCount, rotationSpeed, bloom strength/radius/threshold and dimensionShift are props; activate and shift are exposed through a ref.
weight: heavy: Full Three.js scene with bloom, FXAA, thousands of particles and a frame loop.
demo: Buttons labelled Activate Portal and Shift Dimensions; violet, blue, red and green accent colours.
issues: Frame 1 is so dim the portal is barely visible.
Shift Dimensions picks random colours, so it can land on clashing palettes.
polishWhy: Lush bloom and a readable portal form; the narrow panel and random recolours feel demo-grade.
